name: The Burial Headpiece of the Ancients

system.description:
Value: 2,000 gp | Hengegate Activation: 1/day (5 charges remaining).

Primary Property: Broad Archinium circle engraved with an Archaian Arch. Unlocks the Burial Vault of the Ancient Archaians (Hex O on the Archaia Hex Map) and provides two-way translation between the wielder's language and Ancient Archaian while held.
